integrity: The proof enumerates disjoint configurations under the original closed-neighborhood definition. Finite computation corroborates but does not prove the unrestricted theorem. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a one-step full subdivision of a complete bipartite graph with both parts of size at least two.
The scalar double domination minimum was previously published; the new claim is the complete polynomial and minimum-set counts.
The polynomial is for at-least-two domination, not exact efficient double domination.
Literature comparisons cannot establish absolute publication priority.
title: Double-domination polynomials of subdivisions of complete bipartite graphs
